name: com.eliranshaya.mobileadjustgamequality
description: Three-tier mobile graphics quality for Unity URP - Low, Balanced and High. One button generates the URP assets, renderers, quality levels, Player Settings and a manager prefab. At runtime it picks a tier from the device and keeps the frame budget by adapting render scale from p95 frame time, with thermal awareness.

samples.description: A settings dropdown bound to the three tiers, and a component that turns optional content off and adjusts animator culling when the tier changes.
